## Product Summary
Ward Signup is an independent free online signup sheet for Latter-day Saint wards and branches. Leaders create time slots, set spot limits, and share one link — members sign up with no account needed.

**Core features:**
- Time slot scheduling with capacity limits
- No account required for members
- Shareable signup links
- Automatic email confirmations and reminders
- Real-time signup tracking
- Free during beta

**Common use cases:**
- Tithing declaration appointments
- Youth and adult interviews
- Temple recommend appointments
- Service project shifts
- Teaching assignments
- Volunteer schedules

## Independence Notice
Ward Signup is an **independent** product. It is **not** official Church software and is **not** affiliated with or endorsed by The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.
